mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER t USING DUAL ON (t.ORIGIN_URL = #{originUrl}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TITLE = #{title}, t.CURRENT_PRICE = #{currentPrice}, t.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN /* DEAL_ID는 IDENTITY 설정으로 인해 생략 가능합니다 */ INSERT (ORIGIN_URL, TITLE, CURRENT_PRICE, START_PRICE, MALL_NAME, COMMUNITY_NAME, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) VALUES (#{originUrl}, #{title}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{mallName}, #{communityName}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT DEAL_ID, ORIGIN_URL, TITLE, CURRENT_PRICE, START_PRICE, MALL_NAME, COMMUNITY_NAME, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC
